name: elo-honesty-v1
note: Does UCI_LimitStrength stay honest at the run's real pace (movetime 1000)? Control matchup: 5x5 K+Q+R vs K+R — the stalemate-prone point from the Session H findings (53% mate / 37% stalemate at Elo 1200, 100ms). Honest capping means the checkmate-only winrate is monotone in the cap (500 < 1000 < 1200 << full) and the capped side keeps its imperfections (stalemates/losses) at 1s. If capped ~= full here, the cap is not engaging and every calibration number is suspect.
